# Kostiantyn Osmolovskyi — Research Program on Cognitive Structuring, Change, and Continuity

> Independent research program by Kostiantyn Osmolovskyi concerned with cognitive structuring, structural updating, persistence, continuity, and distributed cognitive organization. The General Theory of Cognitive Structuring (GTCS) is the principal formal-architectural framework of the wider program.

This site is the canonical public map of the research program. It includes primary conceptual research papers, the formal GTCS core, verification and operationalization materials, and specialized branches concerning phenomenological and qualitative readability, inter-system conflict, significance, human psychic processing, and AI safety.

GTCS should not be inferred from any single downstream paper, toy model, simulation, operationalization document, software file, or verification artifact. Computational and reproducibility materials are realization-specific or verification resources and do not define or exhaust the scope of GTCS or of the wider research program.

The wider research program also contains questions and conceptual frameworks that extend beyond what the current formal GTCS architecture itself establishes. Compatibility with GTCS should therefore not be interpreted as making every broader conceptual claim a formal consequence of GTCS.

Author: Kostiantyn Osmolovskyi  
ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0006-3144-7237

## Primary Program Overview

- [Canonical research-program landing page](https://k-osmolovskyi.github.io/): Public description of the research program and complete navigational map of the corpus.
- [Markdown source of the canonical research map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k-osmolovskyi/k-osmolovskyi.github.io/main/README.md): Machine-readable source version of the complete landing page.

## Primary Research Papers

- [Structural Updating and the Limits of Inference in Cognitive Change](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19545676): Examines when observed processing, behavioral, or representational change warrants an inference of structural cognitive change.
- [Cognitive Evolution Beyond the Single Life Cycle: A Framework for Cross-Carrier Continuity and Distributed Processing](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19673721): Develops a framework for cognitive continuity and accumulation beyond a single individual life cycle or carrier.
- [Who Governs What Persists? Retention, Durable Updating, and Continuity Across Cognitive Systems](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21451470): Develops a framework for retention, durable updating, distributed continuity, and continuity-relevant control across cognitive systems.

## Formal GTCS Entry Points

- [General Theory of Cognitive Structuring](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19467207): Synthesis of the principal formal-architectural framework.
- [Verification Package Overview](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19705772): Entry point to the GTCS verification architecture, authority hierarchy, and verification routes.
- [How to Verify the GTCS](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19701901): External procedure for checking definitions, dependencies, results, and scope boundaries.
- [Operationalizing GTCS: From Structural Variables to Observational Proxies](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20039956): Framework for connecting formal GTCS targets to observational, measurement, and computational interfaces.

## Research Map

The canonical landing page contains the complete indexed map of the research corpus, including:

- the GTCS formal core;
- verification and operationalization materials;
- the Phenomenological / Qualitative Readability branch;
- the Inter-System Conflict branch;
- the Significance layer;
- the Human Psychic Processing / Psychological Architecture branch;
- the AI Safety branch;
- computational and toy realizations;
- adjacent and exploratory conceptual work.

Use the complete research map when determining the role, ownership, dependency position, or scope of an individual paper:

- [Complete research map](https://k-osmolovskyi.github.io/#complete-research-map)

## Interpretation Boundaries

- The research program is broader than GTCS.
- GTCS is the principal formal-architectural framework of the program, not the entirety of the program.
- A branch paper does not define GTCS as a whole.
- A toy model or simulation is a downstream realization of declared formal objects, not an independent definition of the theory.
- A verification artifact documents or checks formal claims; it does not replace the owner paper or synthesis.
- An operational proxy, estimator, measurement interface, or software implementation is not automatically identical to the formal object it investigates.
- Cross-carrier continuity, inter-system conflict, phenomenological readability, human psychic processing, significance, and AI safety are distinct research surfaces and should not be collapsed into one another merely because they share interfaces with GTCS.
